prompt:
We have a mess of contact data scattered across our CRM folder at /workspace/crm/raw/ — there are plain-text notes from two sales reps (under sales_reps/) and a CSV export from our old system (under exports/). I need you to consolidate all of this into a single clean contact registry file called consolidated_contacts.json.

Here's what I need:
- Pull contacts from ALL three source files.
- Only include contacts where both the email address AND phone number are genuinely valid. Throw out anything that doesn't look right.
- Remove duplicates — if the same person appears in multiple sources, include them only once.
- Every contact entry should have a unique ID, a timestamp, their email, and their phone.
- The final file should also include a summary section showing how many contacts were processed and when.

Please use the ai_agent_tools library available at /workspace/ai_agent_tools.py to do this. The output file should be placed somewhere inside /workspace/crm/.
